match.userMessage: Storyboard animatic frame. wide. eye level. SCARLETT moves through a dense stream of commuters, her black coat and coral lips standing out against charcoal suits and pale stone buildings. SCARLETT is mid-stride in the crosswalk among commuters, black coat open and swinging. Then: SCARLETT moves with the crowd through the crosswalk. Camera: handheld follow, energetic. Keep SCARLETT distinct within the flow without isolating her from the city. Characters: Scarlett: Woman, 22, A striking, fresh-faced 22-year-old beauty creator: dewy, even skin, high cheekbones, wide dark eyes and a sleek dark bob, wearing Black fitted turtleneck, slim black trousers, small gold hoop earrings. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, correct perspective and depth, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Figures have readable poses, gestures and simple expressive faces. Draw the single opening moment of the shot: each character appears exactly once, and what happens next is shown only by a few bold arrows for the camera move and the way subjects travel. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
